title: The succession of Streckfus boats from the J.S. to the President
summary: Boats run J.S. 1903-10, then a successor to 1920, Capitol 1920-33, then this boat; smaller wooden boats also named.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: The JS then was your first one and that stayed on for a long time? 1903 until 1910.

1910, I know. And then what boat came? Well then the boat all of a sudden succeeded her and she ran from 1910 to 1920. And she was succeeded by the steamer capital from 1920 to 1933. And then this boat came and took over 1933.
And what were the smaller boats?
Well we had boats called the Quincy, the St. Paul, the Sidney, and the Butte. We had four wood boats that time.
